_doc: Local data-center moratoria for build_dc_delay.py. HAND-EDIT. level county → matches registry county; city → matches registry city (or the row's local_moratorium text). blocks new_license (phases not yet started that lack local approval). ban = ballot prohibition (treated as blocked past 2030). end by scenario: base = bear = instrument end (or start + state average duration when open-ended); stress = one renewal of the same length. Coordinates are approximate jurisdiction centroids, for the map only.
source: raw/rules_research.json (rules research 2026-11-06; Moratorium Nation tracker cohort 2026-11-05 + local instruments)

local_counts_active_dc.note: Active+extended local instruments covering data centres (1,293 instruments all sectors; 934 DC active/extended). Counts, not MW: SemiAnalysis 09-15 found ~80% of live restrictions contain no modelled planned capacity; of ~20 GW inside restricted boundaries only 1,525 MW delayed (3 projects: an AWS campus in Ohio, a powered-land campus in PA = NorthPoint/Hazle, a Colorado site).
